_grammar: rules/class_abilities.py, module docstring. The engine reads these fields and never these names.
_alignment_note: Owner ruling 2026-10-05: alignment is not tracked yet, so Smite Evil works on any foe and says so in its text. `evil_only` is off until alignment tracking lands; the engine's check (`_could_be_evil`, a stat block's printed alignment) is kept for that day. Built first with `evil_only` on, a smite at a wolf (printed N) was wasted while one at the world's people, who print nothing, held.

abilities.name: Smite Evil
abilities.source: CRB p.61 Smite Evil: swift action, one target in sight; Cha bonus to attack, paladin level to damage, Cha modifier as a deflection bonus to AC against that target's attacks; until the target is dead or the paladin rests.
abilities.text: Cha to attack, level to damage and Cha deflection AC against one foe. Alignment isn't tracked yet, so this works on any foe for now; it will be limited to evil foes once alignment is added.
not_yet: The first hit's doubled damage against evil outsiders, evil dragons and undead.
Smite attacks bypassing the target's damage reduction.
Ending on the target's death: the mark stays, inert, until the paladin rests.

abilities.name: Lay on Hands
abilities.source: CRB p.61 Lay on Hands: 1d6 per two paladin levels; standard action on another, swift on herself; touch. Against undead: the same dice as damage on a melee touch attack, no save. Mercies (p.62) remove their conditions from whoever is healed.
abilities.text: Heal 1d6 per two levels by touch; swift on yourself.
not_yet: The mercies that act through a spell: diseased (remove disease), cursed (remove curse), poisoned (neutralize poison).
Touch is checked on the map (5 ft); with no map it is taken on trust.

abilities.name: Channel Positive Energy
abilities.source: CRB p.62 Channel Positive Energy: spends two uses of lay on hands; channels as a cleric of her paladin level (CRB p.40: 1d6 + 1d6 per two levels beyond 1st, 30-ft burst, Will DC 10 + 1/2 level + Cha for half).
abilities.text: Heal the living or harm the undead in a 30-ft burst; two uses of lay on hands.
not_yet: With no map, everyone in the scene is in the burst.
Excluding chosen creatures (Selective Channeling): the burst takes everyone it reaches, as the book does.
